common.tagline: A team blog that behaves itself

hero.metaTitle: Postly — a team blog that behaves itself
hero.metaDescription: Multi-tenant team blogging with offline likes, live feeds, per-member timezones and prices that are integers. Built on Ultimate.
hero.title: Publish together. Behave predictably.
hero.subtitle: Orgs, members, drafts, comments and a nightly digest that arrives at 09:00 wherever your writers actually are.
hero.imageAlt: A soft blue gradient behind the Postly headline

features.heading: What you get on day one
features.realtimeBody: A live query, not a polling loop. Your own click lands instantly; everyone else's arrives as it commits.
features.offlineBody: Writes queue while you are offline and reconcile on reconnect. No lost taps, no duplicate rows.
features.localeTitle: Every member's own language and clock
features.localeBody: Locale and timezone are columns on the membership, so a post reads correctly in Madrid and in Auckland.
features.moneyBody: Minor units and a currency, priced per market, formatted once at the edge. Never a float.

pricing.metaTitle: Postly pricing — free, team and business plans
pricing.metaDescription: Three plans priced in US dollars and euros. Seats, drafts, comments and the nightly digest are included on every plan, including the free one.
pricing.heading: Priced per market, not converted
pricing.subheading: Pick a currency at signup. We never guess an exchange rate on your behalf.
pricing.includedList: Live feeds, offline likes, nightly digest, two languages, MCP access

contact.intro: Tell us how many seats you need and which plan you were reading. We answer in one working day.
contact.sent: Thanks — a copy is on its way to your inbox.
contact.failed: That did not send. Try again, or write to sales@postly.example.

blog.metaDescription: Notes on multi-tenant publishing, offline writes, timezone-correct scheduling and integer money.
blog.notFoundBody: The link is old, or the post was unpublished.

offline.metaDescription: You are offline. Postly keeps your feed readable and queues anything you write until the connection returns.
offline.heading: You are offline
offline.body: The feed you already loaded is still readable. Anything you write is queued and sent when the connection returns.
offline.queue: Anything waiting to send stays on this device and goes as soon as you reconnect.

settings.heading: Your preferences
settings.intro: These are stored on your membership, so every surface — web, digest email, admin — agrees.
settings.localeHelp: Applies to the interface and to your digest email.
settings.timezoneHelp: Every date you see is rendered in this zone, and your digest arrives at 09:00 here.
settings.digestHelp: One email at 09:00 your time with what your organisation published.
settings.pushOn: This browser will be notified when someone comments on your posts.
settings.pushDenied: Notifications are blocked for this site — allow them in your browser settings.
settings.pushUnavailable: This browser cannot receive notifications from Postly.
settings.role_select_owner: You own {org}: its plan and its billing are yours.

health.intro: The newest runs of every connected site: how each ended, when, and how much each one did.
health.snapshot: A snapshot: refresh the page to see newer runs.
health.failedHint: the newer half against the older
